PHYSICAL EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t.
   B. Damage equipment used for Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t.
   D. Practise Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.
   B. Damage equipment used for Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.
   D. Practise Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. Best practice when working on Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.
   D. Practise Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Shot put: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Shot put.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Shot put.
   C. Damage equipment used for Shot put.
   D. Practise Shot put with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas.
   D. Practise Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   C. Refuse all feedback on Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol.
   D. Damage equipment used for Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Guarantee a trophy

9. Best practice when working on Discus Throw: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Discus Throw.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Discus Throw.
   C. Practise Discus Throw with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Discus Throw.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

11. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   B. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.

12. Best practice when working on Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki.

----

17. In three clear sentences, explain Discus Throw and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Shot put and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
